description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6685002486975 GAGE,COMPOUND PRESS: Line 0001 Qty 43 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
